description: Write one field of a CRM record directly, as the key holder. Agent (service-account) keys are refused with `crm_agents_must_propose`: they file proposals instead. `commandId` is required: reuse it on a retry so the change applies once. Requires `write` scope.

commandId.description: Idempotency handle (pick a fresh unique value per change; reuse it only to retry): one command id applies once.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

value.description: The new value: a string, number, boolean or null.

name: anyforge_update_crm_record
title: Update crm record
